decisions.notebook: G1 chose Hippo/Excadrill lead, Blaziken(Mega)+Whimsicott back vs GLM's rain-Steel squad. Key verified numbers: Sand Rush Excadrill = 308 Spe, outspeeds Noivern (192 max) and Scarf Staraptor (250); LO EQ = 58-99% on Archaludon (guaranteed 2HKO, spread-reduced), Whimsicott Moonblast = 56-103% on Noivern (Sash makes it 2-hit anyway). Hippowdon (67 Spe) always loses weather order to Politoed (90-122), so Sand Stream overwrites Drizzle whenever both are out - keep Hippo healthy vs their weather resets; Slack Off+Lefties. NEVER click Hippo EQ beside Excadrill (Ground SE into Steel); Hippo spams Yawn/Stealth Rock instead. Watch whether GLM actually brings Politoed into Hippo or pivots to Grimmsnarl screens + Staraptor/Scizor physical mode - if they drop Politoed, G2 consider Pikachu (Fake Out+TWave, Lightning Rod for Electro Shot) or Kingambit (Supreme Overlord vs their slow backline) over Whimsicott. Scarf Staraptor is their fastest anti-Blaziken tool - don't let Mega Blaziken eat Brave Bird before a Speed Boost; para or sand cover it.

reflections.summary: Won because the lead matchup was overwhelmingly favorable: Politoed OHKO'd Hippowdon T1 and Excadrill T2, dismantling the sand core before it could function. Scizor's Bullet Punch removed Whimsicott, and Archaludon survived Blaziken-Mega's Close Combat at 16% thanks to Prankster Reflect going up first plus Stamina, then KO'd back with Draco Meteor. Zero decision errors; the four-brought plan and Scizor-Mega choice suited this opponent well.
reflections.adjustment: No piloting changes needed.
